**手机安装：只需下载 [`dsh-go-1.3.0-arm64.apk`](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/releases/download/v1.3.0/dsh-go-1.3.0-arm64.apk)。**

`update.json` 和 `SHA256SUMS` 供自动更新与校验使用，无需手动下载。GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 是源码包，不是安装包。

**Install on your phone: download [`dsh-go-1.3.0-arm64.apk`](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/releases/download/v1.3.0/dsh-go-1.3.0-arm64.apk).**

`update.json` and `SHA256SUMS` support automatic updates and verification. You do not need to download them manually. GitHub's Source code archives are not installers.

### 中文

- **顶栏一键语音通话。** 首页右上角、新对话按钮旁边多了通话按钮，新对话里也能直接打。
- **长按就能选字。** 长按回复或自己发的消息直接选中按到的词，拖两端改范围；选区上有复制、引用、分享、朗读、全选，「更多」里是原来的消息菜单。自己发的消息也能引用了。朗读选中的文字时，里面的密码、密钥不会念出来。
- **远程主机：对话备份和网页版。** 远程主机页可以把主机上的对话加密备份到手机，再恢复到原来的或另一台主机（每次恢复新建对话，不覆盖；附件和工作区源码不迁移）。主机支持时，还能在 App 里直接打开主机的 DSH 网页版，不用把登录凭据交给浏览器；服务繁忙时会提示「人太多了，请稍后重试」。
- **后台保护（需要自己打开）。** 设置里新增后台运行保护，默认关闭。打开后本机长任务切到后台更不容易被系统杀掉，被系统收回时如实显示，不会假装还在运行。iOS 可以选静音音频或后台定位来保活，都要自己授权，不保存也不上传位置。
- **酒馆。**
  - 支持酒馆助手脚本库：全局、预设、角色卡里的脚本都能运行。预设的脚本能拿到 SillyTavern 的事件和当前预设，像小猫之神这类预设的菜单现在能出来；脚本面板在画布里显示，开关会写回预设。
  - 大卡明显不卡了：重卡导入、卡库列表、长历史显示快了数倍，卡库占用减少约三分之二。前端卡只渲染屏幕上看得见的消息，写回复时少了很多多余重建。新增「省电渲染」开关（酒馆设置 › 显示，默认关）：关掉卡片网页里的毛玻璃，循环动画只播一遍。
  - 上下文满了一次裁掉一截，而不是每条都裁，模型的缓存能持续命中，更快也更省钱（默认开）。
  - 前端卡的开场白不再显示成一堆代码；深色模式下卡片颜色和网页文字看得清；酒馆界面统一了间距、样式和文案，加了克制的动效。
- **伙伴小屋更清晰。** 小屋按屏幕本身的像素密度渲染（之前最多按 2 倍），卡顿时临时降低的清晰度流畅后会自己升回来。
- **新桌宠「小粉鱼」。** 第三只内置宠物，带 18 种状态动画和 3 段待机小动作；切换动作时淡入淡出。
- **分享长图。** 分享成图片时保留完整正文，生成一张长图，不再截掉后半段。
- **本机引擎默认用 tawcroot 启动**（Android 10 及以上）：启动更快；起不来会自动退回原来的兼容启动（PRoot），不弹故障卡。之前手动关过的保持原样。卓易通上 PRoot 启动失败时，故障卡上会出现「用 tawcroot 启动」。
- **修复。** 升级到 1.1.0 后本机新建对话失败；本机用久了会话列表超过 8 MB 就整个加载失败；配了多台 DNS 时第一台拒绝就联网失败；插件配置里 API Key 填不进去；Android 10 用 Shizuku 授权后手机操控报「身份改变」；HyperOS / Android 16 一直 60 Hz（刷新率设置现在也作用到画面本身）；APK 已下好但空间只够一份时误报空间不足；同一路径的图片被覆盖后，旧消息里显示成新图；模型列表接口返回 404 时现在会提示可以手动添加模型；模型选择里过长的名字显示不全；伙伴自动想起记忆时误把子代理配置当成对话内容；桌宠、悬浮窗菜单、伙伴小组件和网页岛的几处显示问题。
- **验证情况。** 这一版的新功能大部分只经过自动测试和编译检查，tawcroot 默认启动、后台保护、远程备份和网页版都没有在各种真机上完整走过。iOS 安装包等 CI 编完会补到这个版本下；鸿蒙 HAP 这一版仍不提供。遇到问题请导出诊断并开 issue。

### English

- **One-tap voice call in the top bar.** A call button sits next to New chat in the top right, and works from a new chat too.
- **Long-press to select text.** Long-press a reply or your own message to select the word under your finger, then drag the handles. The selection bar has Copy, Quote, Share, Read aloud and Select all; More opens the usual message menu. Your own messages can be quoted too. Reading a selection aloud skips any passwords or keys in it.
- **Remote hosts: chat backup and the web app.** The remote host page can back up the host's chats to the phone, encrypted, and restore them to the same or another host (each restore makes a new chat and overwrites nothing; attachments and workspace source are not moved). When the host supports it, you can open its DSH web app inside the app without handing your credentials to a browser; when the service is busy it says so and asks you to try later.
- **Background protection (opt-in).** Settings has a new background protection option, off by default. When on, long local tasks are less likely to be killed in the background, and when the system takes the time back the app says so instead of pretending the engine is still running. On iOS you can choose silent audio or background location to keep it alive; both need your permission, and location is never stored or sent.
- **Tavern.**
  - Tavern Helper script library: scripts from global settings, presets and character cards all run. Preset scripts get SillyTavern's event source and the current preset, so menus from presets such as Meowssiah now show up; the script panel shows in the canvas and its switches are written back to the preset.
  - Large cards no longer stutter: importing heavy cards, the card library list and long histories are several times faster, and the card library takes about a third of the space. Frontend cards only render the messages on screen, and writing a reply triggers far fewer rebuilds. A new Power-saving rendering switch (Tavern settings › Display, off by default) turns off frosted glass in card pages and plays looping animations once.
  - When the context fills up, it is trimmed in one larger step instead of one message at a time, so the model's cache keeps hitting: faster and cheaper (on by default).
  - Frontend cards' opening messages no longer show as raw code; card colors and web text are readable in dark mode; the Tavern screens have consistent spacing, styles and wording, with restrained motion.
- **Sharper companion room.** The room renders at the screen's own pixel density (it was capped at 2x before), and resolution lowered during stutters comes back once things are smooth.
- **New pet: Pink Fish.** A third built-in pet with 18 state animations and 3 idle moments; switching animations now fades.
- **Long share images.** Sharing as an image keeps the whole message and makes one long image instead of cutting off the end.
- **The local engine starts with tawcroot by default** (Android 10 and later): faster to start; if it can't start, the app falls back to the compatible launcher (PRoot) on its own without an error card. If you turned tawcroot off before, that is kept. On Zhuoyitong, when PRoot fails to start the error card offers Start with tawcroot.
- **Fixes.** New local chats failing after upgrading to 1.1.0; the local chat list failing to load once it grew past 8 MB; no network when the first of several configured DNS servers refused; API keys that couldn't be entered in plugin settings; phone control reporting "identity changed" on Android 10 after Shizuku authorization; HyperOS / Android 16 stuck at 60 Hz (the refresh rate setting now applies to the drawing surface too); a false out-of-space error when the APK was already downloaded; older messages showing the new image after a file at the same path was overwritten; a 404 from the model list now says models can be added by hand; long model names cut off in the model picker; the companion's automatic memory recall mistaking subagent settings for conversation; several display issues in pets, the floating menu, the companion widget and web islands.
- **Testing.** Most new features in this version have only been checked by automated tests and builds; tawcroot by default, background protection, remote backup and the web app have not been fully tried on a range of real devices. The iOS package will be added to this release once CI finishes; there is still no HarmonyOS HAP in this version. If you run into a problem, please export diagnostics and open an issue.

Reading a selection aloud skips any passwords or keys in it.
- **Remote hosts: chat backup and the web app.** The remote host page can back up the host's chats to the phone, encrypted, and restore them to the same or another host (each restore makes a new chat and overwrites nothing; attachments and workspace source are not moved). When the host supports it, you can open its DSH web app inside the app without handing your credentials to a browser; when the service is busy it says so and asks you to try later.

When on, long local tasks are less likely to be killed in the background, and when the system takes the time back the app says so instead of pretending the engine is still running. On iOS you can choose silent audio or background location to keep it alive; both need your permission, and location is never stored or sent.

Preset scripts get SillyTavern's event source and the current preset, so menus from presets such as Meowssiah now show up; the script panel shows in the canvas and its switches are written back to the preset.

apps.name: Kernarium
apps.localizedDescription:
### What's new
- **Root access**: apps you allow in Magisk can now run as root. Turn on Root access on Home, and the next start installs the official Magisk app.
- **AOT**: Android's system libraries now run from code translated ahead of time, so Android runs faster. It is on by default, in Performance on Home.
- **120 Hz**: on a ProMotion iPhone or iPad, Android can now run at 120 Hz for smoother motion, using more battery. It is off until you turn it on in Performance on Home.
- **Add to Home Screen**: on iPhone and iPad with iOS 27, put an Android app's icon on the Home Screen, and open the app from there, from Shortcuts or with Siri.
- **VoiceOver and TalkBack**: Andarium now works with VoiceOver. To hear Android's screen, turn on TalkBack under Accessibility.
- **Frame rate when hot**: Android now lowers the frame rate only when the device is very hot. To keep it even then, set When hot to Full frame rate under Performance.
- **Text messages**: Android can now receive a text message that you write. Choose Send text message… in Settings while Android is running, and it arrives as an incoming text.
- **Update notice**: when a newer version is out, Home tells you and shows how to update. It checks once a day, and you can turn it off in Info.
- **iOS 26**: the app now runs on iOS 26 or later.
- Fixes:
  - Fixed the virtual machine's Wi-Fi dropping briefly when you return to Andarium
  - Fixed face scans failing in some apps that use the front camera
  - Fixed connections hanging after the device moves from Wi-Fi to cellular data
  - Fixed apps failing to reach servers for a while after the network returns
  - VP9 videos now play with the device's hardware decoder

### Sideloading
You can sideload the app with [AltStore](https://altstore.io) or [SideStore](https://sidestore.io).

The easy way is to add the source, so updates show up in AltStore or SideStore:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/imxieyi/Kernarium/main/sideload/source.json
```

Alternatively, install the IPA by hand:

1. Download `Andarium-1.1-16.ipa` on the device. It's about 1 GB.
2. Open AltStore or SideStore, tap `+` in **My Apps** and pick the IPA.

A few things to know:

- iOS 26 or later is required.
- The app uses the [Increased Memory Limit](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/bundleresources/entitlements/com.apple.developer.kernel.increased-memory-limit) and [Extended Virtual Addressing](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/bundleresources/entitlements/com.apple.developer.kernel.extended-virtual-addressing) entitlements.
- A free Apple ID works, but the app expires after 7 days and must be refreshed in AltStore or SideStore.
- With a free Apple ID, Android gets less memory. AltStore 2.2 or later keeps the increased memory limit, SideStore doesn't by default. Extended virtual addressing needs a paid developer account.
- JIT is optional and experimental. To use it, assign the universal script to Andarium in [StikDebug](https://github.com/StikDebug/StikDebug) once, then open Andarium from StikDebug.
- To update by hand, install the new IPA with the same Apple ID and the same tool. It replaces the old version and keeps your virtual machine.

### Prebuilt artifacts
- **android-6.18-…-ca1.tar.gz**: the accepted Android kernel bundle. Extract it into `.build/kernel/artifacts/`.
- **lineage24-…-r29.tar.gz**: the accepted Android system release.
- **lineage24-…-r29-aot.tar.gz**: the AOT artifact of that release. Extract both anywhere, then run `android/lineage-24/tools/install-release.py --source <dir>/lineage24-mainline6.18-4k-20261121-los24-r29 --aot-artifact <dir>/lineage24-mainline6.18-4k-20261121-los24-r29-aot`.

apps.localizedDescription:
# S2Arm v0.6.9

这一版主修快照恢复：恢复不再删快照，Mac 上接不上时原地重开这一局；修复部分游戏 60 帧档两倍速；新增 iOS「分配玩家」与实体手柄改键；内存不够的设备起局前先提示。
*This release mainly fixes snapshot restore: restoring never deletes a snapshot, and on Mac a session that cannot take the snapshot in place is relaunched; some games no longer run at double speed in 60 fps mode; iOS gains "Assign players" and physical controller remapping; devices without enough memory get a notice before a game starts.*

## 修复
- **快照恢复修复：快照任何情况下都不再删除**；恢复前按快照记下的原位置重新占好内存；Mac 上接不上时原地重开这一局再恢复；游戏里接不上时先提示去游戏库恢复，不拆当前这一局；本局关着快照时从游戏库恢复不再中途失败；版本变动导致接不上时，提示可在出包页取消这款的「出包时打入」、重新出包后再恢复；旧版本（0.6.8）存下的快照，升到新版本后从游戏库恢复不再被拒。
  *Snapshot restore fixed: a snapshot is never deleted. Memory is reserved at the snapshot's original locations before restoring; on Mac, a session that cannot take the snapshot in place is relaunched and restored; in game, a snapshot that cannot be restored in place points you to the game library instead of ending the session; restoring from the library no longer fails midway when snapshots were off for that session; when a snapshot no longer fits after a change, the notice says to turn off "Add when building" for the game on the build page, rebuild, and restore again. Snapshots saved with the previous version (0.6.8) can be restored from the game library again after updating.*
- **切后台再回来后存的即时快照，恢复后界面文字、图标不再缺失**（#2086，感谢 imneway）。
  *Snapshots saved after switching away and back no longer lose on-screen text and icons when restored (#2086, thanks to imneway).*
- **修复部分游戏 60 帧档两倍速（#2053）**：社区 60 帧补丁里按目标帧率计算的变量，现在按选中的帧率写入，不再一直按 30 帧的值。
  *Fixed some games running at double speed in 60 fps mode (#2053): variables in community 60 fps patches that are computed from the target frame rate are now written for the selected rate instead of staying at their 30 fps values.*
- **修复没打更新的初版（1.0.0）开放世界大作开局不久就闪退**：iPhone / iPad / Mac 都会；修好前的绕法是打上 1.6.0 及以上的游戏更新。
  *Fixed the original 1.0.0 release of a large open-world game crashing shortly after starting, on iPhone, iPad and Mac; until now the workaround was installing game update 1.6.0 or later.*
- **修复部分大型游戏开局后玩一阵就闪退**（地址空间用尽）。
  *Fixed some large games crashing after playing for a while because the address space ran out.*
- **内存不够的设备**：判断装不装得下时按这台设备的物理内存封顶，只在菜单里待了一会儿的短局不再被当成「装得下」的依据；确实装不下时起局前问一次（本款约需多少、这台有多少、可能中途退出），不再一帧没出就被系统结束；这款以前在这台上玩过、留有实测记录时也照样提示。
  *On devices without enough memory, whether a game fits is now judged against the device's physical memory, and a short session spent in a menu no longer counts as proof that it fits; when it does not fit you are asked once before the game starts (how much it needs, how much the device has, it may quit midway) instead of being ended by the system before the first frame, including when the game has been played on this device before.*
- **修复部分游戏开局就断言退出（本机回环网络连接被拒）**：游戏内部用本机回环连接自我唤醒的，现在能照常连上。
  *Fixed some games quitting at launch with an assertion because a local loopback connection was refused: games that wake themselves through a loopback connection now connect normally.*
- **修复部分要 GLES 3 上下文的 SDL 游戏每局开局即崩（#2057）**。
  *Fixed some SDL games that need a GLES 3 context crashing at the start of every session (#2057).*
- **加载页**：着色器还在编就一直等，不再 30 秒到点硬进游戏；「先开始玩，后台继续优化」从优化画面段一开始就可点（#502）。
  *The loading page keeps waiting while shaders are still compiling instead of entering the game after 30 seconds; "Play now, keep optimizing in the background" is available from the start of the optimization stage (#502).*
- **修复部分游戏战斗时敌人血条不显示、长帧（#2051）**。
  *Fixed enemy health bars missing and long frames during battles in some games (#2051).*
- **画面**：修复贴图池在途改写导致采样读到空图闪烁（#674）；内部分辨率下部分计算着色器不再整遍退回原尺寸；遮挡查询重置、事件信号不再打断几何合批（#1449）；计算着色器常量缓冲里的采样器句柄接通（#1594）。
  *Fixed flicker from textures sampled while the texture pool table was being rewritten (#674); some compute shaders no longer fall back to native size under internal resolution; occlusion query resets and event signals no longer break geometry batching (#1449); sampler handles in compute constant buffers are now wired up (#1594).*
- **部分着色器用桌面 OpenGL 老版本写的游戏（如 Darkest Dungeon）不再有声音、没画面**；已装好的请在电脑上对这款点「更新这款」重出一次（#852，感谢 Tony-loading 反复复测）。
  *Some games whose shaders use older desktop OpenGL versions, such as Darkest Dungeon, no longer play sound over a black screen; if the game is already installed, click "Update this game" on the computer once (#852, thanks to Tony-loading for testing again and again).*
- **长时间游玩后回到去过的地方，地面不再出现一直不消失的黑块**（源自 judeyang 的 #2046）。
  *After long play sessions, revisited areas no longer show black patches on the ground that never go away (from #2046 by judeyang).*
- **修复部分游戏开局时偶发的闪退**。
  *Fixed an occasional crash when some games start.*
- **声音**：iOS 音频被打断（来电、其他 App 占用）时继续回收缓冲，游戏不再重开音频输出；恢复快照后缺失的音效状态会重建。
  *During an iOS audio interruption buffers keep being returned so the game does not reopen its audio output; missing audio effect state is rebuilt after restoring a snapshot.*
- **手柄**：iOS 外接手柄十字键不再慢半拍；手柄断开后保留玩家位、重连回到原位（#2036）；Mac 手柄状态不再与系统并发改写（#1819）；Mac 自动识别北通宙斯 NS 并补齐左摇杆（#2039）；Mac 启动设置关掉「体感」后，系统不认、靠兜底读取的手柄也不再把陀螺仪交给游戏（#1383）。
  *The D-pad on external controllers on iOS no longer lags; a disconnected controller keeps its player slot and returns to it on reconnect (#2036); Mac controller state is no longer rewritten concurrently with the system (#1819); Mac recognizes the Betop Zeus NS and its left stick (#2039); on Mac, turning off motion in launch settings also stops motion from controllers read through the fallback path (#1383).*
- **Windows 上登记过两台设备时「更新」找对连着的那台**：原先总去找记录里排第一的那台，不在线就报「这次没列出来」；现在连着的那台排第一。
  *On Windows, with two devices on record, "Update" now targets the one that's connected instead of always the first record, which failed with "not listed" when that device was offline.*
- **Apple ID 团队里还没登记设备时也能导出**：原先导出报笼统的「本地任务失败」；现在照样导出未签名的游戏包，并说清原因和下一步（连上 iPhone 推一次游戏让它登记进团队）。
  *Exporting now works even when your Apple ID team has no registered devices: instead of a generic "local task failed", it exports an unsigned game package and explains why and what to do next (connect your iPhone and push a game once so it's registered).*
- **手机报「签名证书已失效」时说清原因和办法**：原先只说「设备安装失败」；现在写明是别的签名工具刚撤了证书，或手机日期时间不对，并给出办法（打开「设置 → 通用 → 日期与时间」的自动设置后重试；S2Arm 签名前会重新核证书，被撤的换新）。
  *When the phone reports the signing certificate is no longer valid, S2Arm now explains why (another signing tool just revoked it, or the phone's date and time are wrong) and what to do (turn on automatic date and time, then retry; S2Arm re-checks the certificate before signing and replaces a revoked one), instead of a generic install failure.*
- **出包与装机**：Switch 2 版共用 Switch 1 本体 DLC 号段时不再被拒；Windows 上着色器编译超时连同子进程一起停、不再永远挂住；并发写进度文件不再让出包失败（#2034）；别的工具装的 S2Arm 比启动器旧时，接口兼容就提示后继续（#1842）；空的 RomFS 镜像保留并校验，资源镜像按顺序写出时也显示进度；「更新这款」只重算变了的部分；Apple ID 登录辅助服务器异常、硬盘读写故障、硬盘写满、长时间无进展各有自己的原因句；钥匙串里没有签名身份的证书不再算作手机上的证书。
  *Switch 2 versions that share the Switch 1 base game's DLC range are no longer refused; on Windows a timed-out shader compile is stopped with its child processes instead of hanging; concurrent writes to the progress file no longer fail a build (#2034); an S2Arm installed by another tool that is older than the launcher can continue after a notice when compatible (#1842); empty RomFS images are kept and verified, and ordered resource image writes show progress; "Update this game" recomputes only what changed; Apple ID sign-in helper errors, disk I/O failures, a full disk and long stalls each get their own reason; a certificate without a signing identity in the keychain no longer counts as the phone's certificate.*
- **推过多台手机时，「更新 S2Arm」只看连着的那台**：原先总拿记录里排第一的那台提示、甚至往没连着的那台推；现在有手机连着时提示和按钮只看连着的，Mac 也能认出连着的是哪台（#2088）。
  *If you have pushed to more than one phone, "Update S2Arm" now looks only at the phones currently connected: it no longer prompts for, or pushes to, a phone that isn't connected just because it came first in the records, and the Mac launcher now recognizes which phone is connected (#2088).*
- **D2R-Mobile 下游移植包更新到 v2.3.4**，升级后在 iPhone 上出包不再停在「登记翻译链」这一步。
  *The D2R-Mobile downstream port is updated to v2.3.4; building for iPhone after updating no longer stops at the "registering the translation chain" step.*
- **出包、更新失败时，失败原因的开头写清是什么错**，不再只剩一串调用栈的结尾。
  *When a build or update fails, the reason now starts with what went wrong instead of only the tail of a call stack.*
- **Mac 游戏库：免费签名到期只在选中游戏的设备操作区提示一次**，不再把「可在 Mac 上运行」一起标红；iPhone 版 S2Arm 有新版只在顶栏提示（源自 Xc1Ym 的 #2091）。
  *Mac game library: a free signature's expiry now shows once, in the selected game's device actions, and no longer turns "Can run on Mac" red; a new version of S2Arm for iPhone is announced only in the top bar (from #2091 by Xc1Ym).*
- **接 iPad 时不再写死 iPhone（源自 ChuBL 的 #1962）**：导出页推完程序包后的等待提示、游戏库和大图上的「已推到」都按实际设备写；0.6.9 之前装的记录写「iPhone / iPad」，重新推一次后按设备写。
  *iPad is no longer called iPhone (from ChuBL’s #1962): the wait notice on the export page after pushing a program and the "On …" status in the library and hero view name the actual device; installs from before 0.6.9 read "iPhone / iPad" until the game is pushed again.*
- **Mac 键位弹窗和进游戏用的是同一套（源自 ChuBL 的 #2081）**：这款存的键位文件坏了（不合规、缺字段、不是 JSON）时，弹窗和游戏都回到所有游戏的默认（没设过就是标准键位），弹窗照实提示读不出来；不是 JSON 时也不会再起不了局。
  *The Mac key map window and the game now use the same key map (from ChuBL’s #2081): if this game's saved key map is broken (invalid, incomplete or not JSON), both fall back to your default for all games (or the standard map) and the window says it couldn't be read; a non-JSON file no longer stops the game from starting.*
- **触屏游戏里左键仍当触屏，只要没改左键和鼠标模式（源自 ChuBL 的 #1987 / #2083）**：原先改了任何一个按键、或设了所有游戏的默认，Mac / iPad 都会判成「动过鼠标」，左键又当游戏键、点不了画面上的开始；现在只看左键绑在哪、鼠标模式是什么。
  *In touch games the left click keeps acting as a touch unless you changed the left button or mouse mode (from ChuBL’s #1987 / #2083): changing any other key or setting a default for all games no longer makes Mac / iPad treat the mouse as "changed" and stop letting you tap on-screen buttons.*
- **iPad 改键页「使用鼠标 / 触控板」开关（源自 ChuBL 的 #2072 / #2082）**：只想用键盘玩时关掉它，点触控板就当手指点屏幕（叫出虚拟按键、点画面），不再误按游戏键、不锁指针；按游戏存，可随「设为所有游戏的默认」一起设。
  *"Use mouse / trackpad" switch on the iPad key map page (from ChuBL’s #2072 / #2082): turn it off to play with the keyboard only, and a trackpad click acts like a finger tap (bringing up the on-screen controls or tapping the screen) instead of pressing a game button or locking the pointer; saved per game and included in "Set as default for all games".*
- **iPad 改键页「设为所有游戏的默认」（源自 ChuBL 的 #1987 / #2079）**：调好的一套键位一点设成所有游戏的默认，约 5 秒内可撤销；已单独调过的游戏不受影响，新加的游戏直接用这套。
  *"Set as default for all games" on the iPad key map page (from ChuBL’s #1987 / #2079): make your key map the default for every game in one tap, with about 5 seconds to undo; games you set up separately keep their own, and newly added games use it.*
- **iPad 改键页「清除按键设置」一次清掉键盘键和鼠标键（源自 ChuBL 的 #2071 / #2074）**：原先只清键盘那半，按触控板左键还会触发。
  *"Clear key settings" on the iPad key map page now clears both the keyboard key and the mouse button (from ChuBL’s #2071 / #2074); it used to clear only the keyboard half, so the trackpad click still triggered the button.*
- **「更新这款」做不齐时说清楚原因，缺原件可以就地补（源自 ChuBL 的 #1961）**：分清是没装 Metal 开发工具、要在出包页重新出包，还是原件也不在；原件不在时黄字下给「重新添加原件…」，只认这一款，选错了不改游戏库。
  *"Update this game" now says why it couldn't finish, and you can re-add a missing original right there (from ChuBL’s #1961): it tells apart missing Metal tools, a needed rebuild on the build page, and a missing original; for the last, "Re-add original…" appears under the notice, accepts only this game, and leaves the library unchanged if you pick a different one.*
- **Mac 首页「S2Arm」卡按上次装的设备画 iPad / iPhone（源自 ChuBL 的 #1967）**：不用等点进去现查；不知道是哪种时画通用设备图标；选中后卡片上放 S2Arm 图标。
  *The "S2Arm" card on the Mac home page draws iPad or iPhone from the last install instead of waiting for a live check (from ChuBL’s #1967); an unknown device gets a generic icon, and the selected card shows the S2Arm icon.*
- **Mac 存档页说清楚（源自 ChuBL 的 #2066）**：写明这一页管的是这台 Mac 上的存档；没在这台 Mac 上玩过的游戏，恢复的存档会显示「已放好 N 个文件，第一次在这台 Mac 上启动时放进存档」，可以「不要了」；访达压的 zip 不再带进 `__MACOSX`。
  *Mac save page is clearer (from ChuBL’s #2066): it says it manages the saves on this Mac; for a game never played on this Mac, a restored save shows as waiting to go in the first time you start the game here, and can be discarded; zips made by Finder no longer bring in `__MACOSX`.*
- **iOS 设置里给 S2Arm 单独选的语言全都生效（源自 ChuBL 的 #2069）**：系统是英文、在「设置 → S2Arm → 语言」选了中文时，存档报错、诊断上传等提示也跟着出中文，不再中英混杂。
  *Language chosen for S2Arm in iOS Settings now applies everywhere (from ChuBL’s #2069): with the system in English and S2Arm set to Chinese, save errors and diagnostic upload notices follow the app language too.*
- **其他**：修复一款游戏补丁表竞争导致的偶发崩溃；安卓上出包预编库前后两段接口对不上时退回现编，分离采样器来源不再丢失。
  *Fixed an occasional crash from a race on one game's patch table; on Android, prebuilt pipelines whose stages do not match fall back to compiling on device, and separate sampler sources are kept.*

## 已知变化
- **iOS 26 上少数大型游戏不能存快照**：这些游戏要用的地址范围比系统给 App 的多，放不下快照，游戏内菜单里会写明原因（和存储空间无关，游戏照常能玩）；之前存下的快照照样可以从游戏库恢复。
  *On iOS 26 a few large games cannot save snapshots: they need more address range than the system gives an app, so there is no room for a snapshot. The in-game menu explains why (it is not about storage, and the game plays normally); snapshots saved earlier can still be restored from the game library.*

## 新功能
- **iPhone / iPad 游戏库设置新增「游戏来源」**：把电脑导出的游戏（.s2arm 和 .img）放在外接硬盘等文件夹里，直接从那里玩，不用拷进手机；Mac 游戏库也放在这块盘上时，一块盘两端通用。硬盘要用 APFS 格式；没接上时游戏显示为灰色，接上自动恢复。
  *New on iPhone and iPad: Game sources in the library settings. Put games exported from the computer (.s2arm and .img) in a folder, for example on an external drive, and play them from there without copying them in; with the Mac game library on the same drive, one drive works for both. The drive needs to be APFS; while it isn't connected, its games show greyed out and come back when it is.*
- **iPhone / iPad「存档管理」能导入其他模拟器 / 工具的存档（源自 ChuBL 的 #2070）**：「选择备份并检查…」除了 S2Arm 的 .s2asave，也能选 JKSV、Checkpoint、Ryujinx、yuzu 等的存档文件夹或 zip；确认后先备份当前存档，下次开始游戏时读入。只选了单个存档文件或认不出时会说清楚原因。
  *"Manage saves" on iPhone / iPad can import saves from other emulators and tools (from ChuBL’s #2070): besides S2Arm .s2asave backups, "Choose a backup to check…" accepts a save folder or zip from JKSV, Checkpoint, Ryujinx, yuzu and others; your current save is backed up first and the new one is loaded the next time you start the game. Picking a single save file or an unrecognized save now explains why.*
- **iOS「分配玩家」与实体手柄改键**（源自 Ting2024 的 #1606）：游戏内齿轮菜单「分配玩家…」，在哪只手柄上按一下键就登记成下一位玩家，与 Mac 同一份顺序表；实体手柄按这一款的键位改键。
  *iOS "Assign players" and physical controller remapping (from Ting2024's #1606): choose "Assign Players…" in the in-game gear menu and press a button on each controller to register players in order, using the same order table as Mac; physical controllers follow the game's key map.*
- **Mac 手柄**：关掉「切到别的窗口时暂停」后，切到别的窗口手柄照样操作游戏；启动器录键可以录修饰键组合；分配玩家时兜底读取的手柄接上即加入（#1151）。
  *Mac controllers keep controlling the game in other windows when "Pause when switching away" is off; the launcher can record modifier-key combinations; controllers read through the fallback path join as soon as they connect when assigning players (#1151).*
- **Mac 可直接把游戏与 Mod 推到 LiveContainer**，并显示导入与删除状态（#2010、#2012）。
  *Mac can push games and mods directly to LiveContainer and shows import and removal status (#2010, #2012).*

# S2Arm v0.6.9

这一版主修快照恢复：恢复不再删快照，Mac 上接不上时原地重开这一局；修复部分游戏 60 帧档两倍速；新增 iOS「分配玩家」与实体手柄改键；内存不够的设备起局前先提示。
*This release mainly fixes snapshot restore: restoring never deletes a snapshot, and on Mac a session that cannot take the snapshot in place is relaunched; some games no longer run at double speed in 60 fps mode; iOS gains "Assign players" and physical controller remapping; devices without enough memory get a notice before a game starts.*

## 修复
- **快照恢复修复：快照任何情况下都不再删除**；恢复前按快照记下的原位置重新占好内存；Mac 上接不上时原地重开这一局再恢复；游戏里接不上时先提示去游戏库恢复，不拆当前这一局；本局关着快照时从游戏库恢复不再中途失败；版本变动导致接不上时，提示可在出包页取消这款的「出包时打入」、重新出包后再恢复；旧版本（0.6.8）存下的快照，升到新版本后从游戏库恢复不再被拒。
  *Snapshot restore fixed: a snapshot is never deleted. Memory is reserved at the snapshot's original locations before restoring; on Mac, a session that cannot take the snapshot in place is relaunched and restored; in game, a snapshot that cannot be restored in place points you to the game library instead of ending the session; restoring from the library no longer fails midway when snapshots were off for that session; when a snapshot no longer fits after a change, the notice says to turn off "Add when building" for the game on the build page, rebuild, and restore again. Snapshots saved with the previous version (0.6.8) can be restored from the game library again after updating.*
- **切后台再回来后存的即时快照，恢复后界面文字、图标不再缺失**（#2086，感谢 imneway）。
  *Snapshots saved after switching away and back no longer lose on-screen text and icons when restored (#2086, thanks to imneway).*
- **修复部分游戏 60 帧档两倍速（#2053）**：社区 60 帧补丁里按目标帧率计算的变量，现在按选中的帧率写入，不再一直按 30 帧的值。
  *Fixed some games running at double speed in 60 fps mode (#2053): variables in community 60 fps patches that are computed from the target frame rate are now written for the selected rate instead of staying at their 30 fps values.*
- **修复没打更新的初版（1.0.0）开放世界大作开局不久就闪退**：iPhone / iPad / Mac 都会；修好前的绕法是打上 1.6.0 及以上的游戏更新。
  *Fixed the original 1.0.0 release of a large open-world game crashing shortly after starting, on iPhone, iPad and Mac; until now the workaround was installing game update 1.6.0 or later.*
- **修复部分大型游戏开局后玩一阵就闪退**（地址空间用尽）。
  *Fixed some large games crashing after playing for a while because the address space ran out.*
- **内存不够的设备**：判断装不装得下时按这台设备的物理内存封顶，只在菜单里待了一会儿的短局不再被当成「装得下」的依据；确实装不下时起局前问一次（本款约需多少、这台有多少、可能中途退出），不再一帧没出就被系统结束；这款以前在这台上玩过、留有实测记录时也照样提示。
  *On devices without enough memory, whether a game fits is now judged against the device's physical memory, and a short session spent in a menu no longer counts as proof that it fits; when it does not fit you are asked once before the game starts (how much it needs, how much the device has, it may quit midway) instead of being ended by the system before the first frame, including when the game has been played on this device before.*
- **修复部分游戏开局就断言退出（本机回环网络连接被拒）**：游戏内部用本机回环连接自我唤醒的，现在能照常连上。
  *Fixed some games quitting at launch with an assertion because a local loopback connection was refused: games that wake themselves through a loopback connection now connect normally.*
- **修复部分要 GLES 3 上下文的 SDL 游戏每局开局即崩（#2057）**。
  *Fixed some SDL games that need a GLES 3 context crashing at the start of every session (#2057).*
- **加载页**：着色器还在编就一直等，不再 30 秒到点硬进游戏；「先开始玩，后台继续优化」从优化画面段一开始就可点（#502）。
  *The loading page keeps waiting while shaders are still compiling instead of entering the game after 30 seconds; "Play now, keep optimizing in the background" is available from the start of the optimization stage (#502).*
- **修复部分游戏战斗时敌人血条不显示、长帧（#2051）**。
  *Fixed enemy health bars missing and long frames during battles in some games (#2051).*
- **画面**：修复贴图池在途改写导致采样读到空图闪烁（#674）；内部分辨率下部分计算着色器不再整遍退回原尺寸；遮挡查询重置、事件信号不再打断几何合批（#1449）；计算着色器常量缓冲里的采样器句柄接通（#1594）。
  *Fixed flicker from textures sampled while the texture pool table was being rewritten (#674); some compute shaders no longer fall back to native size under internal resolution; occlusion query resets and event signals no longer break geometry batching (#1449); sampler handles in compute constant buffers are now wired up (#1594).*
- **部分着色器用桌面 OpenGL 老版本写的游戏（如 Darkest Dungeon）不再有声音、没画面**；已装好的请在电脑上对这款点「更新这款」重出一次（#852，感谢 Tony-loading 反复复测）。
  *Some games whose shaders use older desktop OpenGL versions, such as Darkest Dungeon, no longer play sound over a black screen; if the game is already installed, click "Update this game" on the computer once (#852, thanks to Tony-loading for testing again and again).*
- **长时间游玩后回到去过的地方，地面不再出现一直不消失的黑块**（源自 judeyang 的 #2046）。
  *After long play sessions, revisited areas no longer show black patches on the ground that never go away (from #2046 by judeyang).*
- **修复部分游戏开局时偶发的闪退**。
  *Fixed an occasional crash when some games start.*
- **声音**：iOS 音频被打断（来电、其他 App 占用）时继续回收缓冲，游戏不再重开音频输出；恢复快照后缺失的音效状态会重建。
  *During an iOS audio interruption buffers keep being returned so the game does not reopen its audio output; missing audio effect state is rebuilt after restoring a snapshot.*
- **手柄**：iOS 外接手柄十字键不再慢半拍；手柄断开后保留玩家位、重连回到原位（#2036）；Mac 手柄状态不再与系统并发改写（#1819）；Mac 自动识别北通宙斯 NS 并补齐左摇杆（#2039）；Mac 启动设置关掉「体感」后，系统不认、靠兜底读取的手柄也不再把陀螺仪交给游戏（#1383）。
  *The D-pad on external controllers on iOS no longer lags; a disconnected controller keeps its player slot and returns to it on reconnect (#2036); Mac controller state is no longer rewritten concurrently with the system (#1819); Mac recognizes the Betop Zeus NS and its left stick (#2039); on Mac, turning off motion in launch settings also stops motion from controllers read through the fallback path (#1383).*
- **Windows 上登记过两台设备时「更新」找对连着的那台**：原先总去找记录里排第一的那台，不在线就报「这次没列出来」；现在连着的那台排第一。
  *On Windows, with two devices on record, "Update" now targets the one that's connected instead of always the first record, which failed with "not listed" when that device was offline.*
- **Apple ID 团队里还没登记设备时也能导出**：原先导出报笼统的「本地任务失败」；现在照样导出未签名的游戏包，并说清原因和下一步（连上 iPhone 推一次游戏让它登记进团队）。
  *Exporting now works even when your Apple ID team has no registered devices: instead of a generic "local task failed", it exports an unsigned game package and explains why and what to do next (connect your iPhone and push a game once so it's registered).*
- **手机报「签名证书已失效」时说清原因和办法**：原先只说「设备安装失败」；现在写明是别的签名工具刚撤了证书，或手机日期时间不对，并给出办法（打开「设置 → 通用 → 日期与时间」的自动设置后重试；S2Arm 签名前会重新核证书，被撤的换新）。
  *When the phone reports the signing certificate is no longer valid, S2Arm now explains why (another signing tool just revoked it, or the phone's date and time are wrong) and what to do (turn on automatic date and time, then retry; S2Arm re-checks the certificate before signing and replaces a revoked one), instead of a generic install failure.*
- **出包与装机**：Switch 2 版共用 Switch 1 本体 DLC 号段时不再被拒；Windows 上着色器编译超时连同子进程一起停、不再永远挂住；并发写进度文件不再让出包失败（#2034）；别的工具装的 S2Arm 比启动器旧时，接口兼容就提示后继续（#1842）；空的 RomFS 镜像保留并校验，资源镜像按顺序写出时也显示进度；「更新这款」只重算变了的部分；Apple ID 登录辅助服务器异常、硬盘读写故障、硬盘写满、长时间无进展各有自己的原因句；钥匙串里没有签名身份的证书不再算作手机上的证书。
  *Switch 2 versions that share the Switch 1 base game's DLC range are no longer refused; on Windows a timed-out shader compile is stopped with its child processes instead of hanging; concurrent writes to the progress file no longer fail a build (#2034); an S2Arm installed by another tool that is older than the launcher can continue after a notice when compatible (#1842); empty RomFS images are kept and verified, and ordered resource image writes show progress; "Update this game" recomputes only what changed; Apple ID sign-in helper errors, disk I/O failures, a full disk and long stalls each get their own reason; a certificate without a signing identity in the keychain no longer counts as the phone's certificate.*
- **推过多台手机时，「更新 S2Arm」只看连着的那台**：原先总拿记录里排第一的那台提示、甚至往没连着的那台推；现在有手机连着时提示和按钮只看连着的，Mac 也能认出连着的是哪台（#2088）。
  *If you have pushed to more than one phone, "Update S2Arm" now looks only at the phones currently connected: it no longer prompts for, or pushes to, a phone that isn't connected just because it came first in the records, and the Mac launcher now recognizes which phone is connected (#2088).*
- **D2R-Mobile 下游移植包更新到 v2.3.4**，升级后在 iPhone 上出包不再停在「登记翻译链」这一步。
  *The D2R-Mobile downstream port is updated to v2.3.4; building for iPhone after updating no longer stops at the "registering the translation chain" step.*
- **出包、更新失败时，失败原因的开头写清是什么错**，不再只剩一串调用栈的结尾。
  *When a build or update fails, the reason now starts with what went wrong instead of only the tail of a call stack.*
- **Mac 游戏库：免费签名到期只在选中游戏的设备操作区提示一次**，不再把「可在 Mac 上运行」一起标红；iPhone 版 S2Arm 有新版只在顶栏提示（源自 Xc1Ym 的 #2091）。
  *Mac game library: a free signature's expiry now shows once, in the selected game's device actions, and no longer turns "Can run on Mac" red; a new version of S2Arm for iPhone is announced only in the top bar (from #2091 by Xc1Ym).*
- **接 iPad 时不再写死 iPhone（源自 ChuBL 的 #1962）**：导出页推完程序包后的等待提示、游戏库和大图上的「已推到」都按实际设备写；0.6.9 之前装的记录写「iPhone / iPad」，重新推一次后按设备写。
  *iPad is no longer called iPhone (from ChuBL’s #1962): the wait notice on the export page after pushing a program and the "On …" status in the library and hero view name the actual device; installs from before 0.6.9 read "iPhone / iPad" until the game is pushed again.*
- **Mac 键位弹窗和进游戏用的是同一套（源自 ChuBL 的 #2081）**：这款存的键位文件坏了（不合规、缺字段、不是 JSON）时，弹窗和游戏都回到所有游戏的默认（没设过就是标准键位），弹窗照实提示读不出来；不是 JSON 时也不会再起不了局。
  *The Mac key map window and the game now use the same key map (from ChuBL’s #2081): if this game's saved key map is broken (invalid, incomplete or not JSON), both fall back to your default for all games (or the standard map) and the window says it couldn't be read; a non-JSON file no longer stops the game from starting.*
- **触屏游戏里左键仍当触屏，只要没改左键和鼠标模式（源自 ChuBL 的 #1987 / #2083）**：原先改了任何一个按键、或设了所有游戏的默认，Mac / iPad 都会判成「动过鼠标」，左键又当游戏键、点不了画面上的开始；现在只看左键绑在哪、鼠标模式是什么。
  *In touch games the left click keeps acting as a touch unless you changed the left button or mouse mode (from ChuBL’s #1987 / #2083): changing any other key or setting a default for all games no longer makes Mac / iPad treat the mouse as "changed" and stop letting you tap on-screen buttons.*
- **iPad 改键页「使用鼠标 / 触控板」开关（源自 ChuBL 的 #2072 / #2082）**：只想用键盘玩时关掉它，点触控板就当手指点屏幕（叫出虚拟按键、点画面），不再误按游戏键、不锁指针；按游戏存，可随「设为所有游戏的默认」一起设。
  *"Use mouse / trackpad" switch on the iPad key map page (from ChuBL’s #2072 / #2082): turn it off to play with the keyboard only, and a trackpad click acts like a finger tap (bringing up the on-screen controls or tapping the screen) instead of pressing a game button or locking the pointer; saved per game and included in "Set as default for all games".*
- **iPad 改键页「设为所有游戏的默认」（源自 ChuBL 的 #1987 / #2079）**：调好的一套键位一点设成所有游戏的默认，约 5 秒内可撤销；已单独调过的游戏不受影响，新加的游戏直接用这套。
  *"Set as default for all games" on the iPad key map page (from ChuBL’s #1987 / #2079): make your key map the default for every game in one tap, with about 5 seconds to undo; games you set up separately keep their own, and newly added games use it.*
- **iPad 改键页「清除按键设置」一次清掉键盘键和鼠标键（源自 ChuBL 的 #2071 / #2074）**：原先只清键盘那半，按触控板左键还会触发。
  *"Clear key settings" on the iPad key map page now clears both the keyboard key and the mouse button (from ChuBL’s #2071 / #2074); it used to clear only the keyboard half, so the trackpad click still triggered the button.*
- **「更新这款」做不齐时说清楚原因，缺原件可以就地补（源自 ChuBL 的 #1961）**：分清是没装 Metal 开发工具、要在出包页重新出包，还是原件也不在；原件不在时黄字下给「重新添加原件…」，只认这一款，选错了不改游戏库。
  *"Update this game" now says why it couldn't finish, and you can re-add a missing original right there (from ChuBL’s #1961): it tells apart missing Metal tools, a needed rebuild on the build page, and a missing original; for the last, "Re-add original…" appears under the notice, accepts only this game, and leaves the library unchanged if you pick a different one.*
- **Mac 首页「S2Arm」卡按上次装的设备画 iPad / iPhone（源自 ChuBL 的 #1967）**：不用等点进去现查；不知道是哪种时画通用设备图标；选中后卡片上放 S2Arm 图标。
  *The "S2Arm" card on the Mac home page draws iPad or iPhone from the last install instead of waiting for a live check (from ChuBL’s #1967); an unknown device gets a generic icon, and the selected card shows the S2Arm icon.*
- **Mac 存档页说清楚（源自 ChuBL 的 #2066）**：写明这一页管的是这台 Mac 上的存档；没在这台 Mac 上玩过的游戏，恢复的存档会显示「已放好 N 个文件，第一次在这台 Mac 上启动时放进存档」，可以「不要了」；访达压的 zip 不再带进 `__MACOSX`。
  *Mac save page is clearer (from ChuBL’s #2066): it says it manages the saves on this Mac; for a game never played on this Mac, a restored save shows as waiting to go in the first time you start the game here, and can be discarded; zips made by Finder no longer bring in `__MACOSX`.*
- **iOS 设置里给 S2Arm 单独选的语言全都生效（源自 ChuBL 的 #2069）**：系统是英文、在「设置 → S2Arm → 语言」选了中文时，存档报错、诊断上传等提示也跟着出中文，不再中英混杂。
  *Language chosen for S2Arm in iOS Settings now applies everywhere (from ChuBL’s #2069): with the system in English and S2Arm set to Chinese, save errors and diagnostic upload notices follow the app language too.*
- **其他**：修复一款游戏补丁表竞争导致的偶发崩溃；安卓上出包预编库前后两段接口对不上时退回现编，分离采样器来源不再丢失。
  *Fixed an occasional crash from a race on one game's patch table; on Android, prebuilt pipelines whose stages do not match fall back to compiling on device, and separate sampler sources are kept.*

## 已知变化
- **iOS 26 上少数大型游戏不能存快照**：这些游戏要用的地址范围比系统给 App 的多，放不下快照，游戏内菜单里会写明原因（和存储空间无关，游戏照常能玩）；之前存下的快照照样可以从游戏库恢复。
  *On iOS 26 a few large games cannot save snapshots: they need more address range than the system gives an app, so there is no room for a snapshot. The in-game menu explains why (it is not about storage, and the game plays normally); snapshots saved earlier can still be restored from the game library.*

## 新功能
- **iPhone / iPad 游戏库设置新增「游戏来源」**：把电脑导出的游戏（.s2arm 和 .img）放在外接硬盘等文件夹里，直接从那里玩，不用拷进手机；Mac 游戏库也放在这块盘上时，一块盘两端通用。硬盘要用 APFS 格式；没接上时游戏显示为灰色，接上自动恢复。
  *New on iPhone and iPad: Game sources in the library settings. Put games exported from the computer (.s2arm and .img) in a folder, for example on an external drive, and play them from there without copying them in; with the Mac game library on the same drive, one drive works for both. The drive needs to be APFS; while it isn't connected, its games show greyed out and come back when it is.*
- **iPhone / iPad「存档管理」能导入其他模拟器 / 工具的存档（源自 ChuBL 的 #2070）**：「选择备份并检查…」除了 S2Arm 的 .s2asave，也能选 JKSV、Checkpoint、Ryujinx、yuzu 等的存档文件夹或 zip；确认后先备份当前存档，下次开始游戏时读入。只选了单个存档文件或认不出时会说清楚原因。
  *"Manage saves" on iPhone / iPad can import saves from other emulators and tools (from ChuBL’s #2070): besides S2Arm .s2asave backups, "Choose a backup to check…" accepts a save folder or zip from JKSV, Checkpoint, Ryujinx, yuzu and others; your current save is backed up first and the new one is loaded the next time you start the game. Picking a single save file or an unrecognized save now explains why.*
- **iOS「分配玩家」与实体手柄改键**（源自 Ting2024 的 #1606）：游戏内齿轮菜单「分配玩家…」，在哪只手柄上按一下键就登记成下一位玩家，与 Mac 同一份顺序表；实体手柄按这一款的键位改键。
  *iOS "Assign players" and physical controller remapping (from Ting2024's #1606): choose "Assign Players…" in the in-game gear menu and press a button on each controller to register players in order, using the same order table as Mac; physical controllers follow the game's key map.*
- **Mac 手柄**：关掉「切到别的窗口时暂停」后，切到别的窗口手柄照样操作游戏；启动器录键可以录修饰键组合；分配玩家时兜底读取的手柄接上即加入（#1151）。
  *Mac controllers keep controlling the game in other windows when "Pause when switching away" is off; the launcher can record modifier-key combinations; controllers read through the fallback path join as soon as they connect when assigning players (#1151).*
- **Mac 可直接把游戏与 Mod 推到 LiveContainer**，并显示导入与删除状态（#2010、#2012）。
  *Mac can push games and mods directly to LiveContainer and shows import and removal status (#2010, #2012).*

# S2Arm v0.6.9

这一版主修快照恢复：恢复不再删快照，Mac 上接不上时原地重开这一局；修复部分游戏 60 帧档两倍速；新增 iOS「分配玩家」与实体手柄改键；内存不够的设备起局前先提示。
*This release mainly fixes snapshot restore: restoring never deletes a snapshot, and on Mac a session that cannot take the snapshot in place is relaunched; some games no longer run at double speed in 60 fps mode; iOS gains "Assign players" and physical controller remapping; devices without enough memory get a notice before a game starts.*

## 修复
- **快照恢复修复：快照任何情况下都不再删除**；恢复前按快照记下的原位置重新占好内存；Mac 上接不上时原地重开这一局再恢复；游戏里接不上时先提示去游戏库恢复，不拆当前这一局；本局关着快照时从游戏库恢复不再中途失败；版本变动导致接不上时，提示可在出包页取消这款的「出包时打入」、重新出包后再恢复；旧版本（0.6.8）存下的快照，升到新版本后从游戏库恢复不再被拒。
  *Snapshot restore fixed: a snapshot is never deleted. Memory is reserved at the snapshot's original locations before restoring; on Mac, a session that cannot take the snapshot in place is relaunched and restored; in game, a snapshot that cannot be restored in place points you to the game library instead of ending the session; restoring from the library no longer fails midway when snapshots were off for that session; when a snapshot no longer fits after a change, the notice says to turn off "Add when building" for the game on the build page, rebuild, and restore again. Snapshots saved with the previous version (0.6.8) can be restored from the game library again after updating.*
- **切后台再回来后存的即时快照，恢复后界面文字、图标不再缺失**（#2086，感谢 imneway）。
  *Snapshots saved after switching away and back no longer lose on-screen text and icons when restored (#2086, thanks to imneway).*
- **修复部分游戏 60 帧档两倍速（#2053）**：社区 60 帧补丁里按目标帧率计算的变量，现在按选中的帧率写入，不再一直按 30 帧的值。
  *Fixed some games running at double speed in 60 fps mode (#2053): variables in community 60 fps patches that are computed from the target frame rate are now written for the selected rate instead of staying at their 30 fps values.*
- **修复没打更新的初版（1.0.0）开放世界大作开局不久就闪退**：iPhone / iPad / Mac 都会；修好前的绕法是打上 1.6.0 及以上的游戏更新。
  *Fixed the original 1.0.0 release of a large open-world game crashing shortly after starting, on iPhone, iPad and Mac; until now the workaround was installing game update 1.6.0 or later.*
- **修复部分大型游戏开局后玩一阵就闪退**（地址空间用尽）。
  *Fixed some large games crashing after playing for a while because the address space ran out.*
- **内存不够的设备**：判断装不装得下时按这台设备的物理内存封顶，只在菜单里待了一会儿的短局不再被当成「装得下」的依据；确实装不下时起局前问一次（本款约需多少、这台有多少、可能中途退出），不再一帧没出就被系统结束；这款以前在这台上玩过、留有实测记录时也照样提示。
  *On devices without enough memory, whether a game fits is now judged against the device's physical memory, and a short session spent in a menu no longer counts as proof that it fits; when it does not fit you are asked once before the game starts (how much it needs, how much the device has, it may quit midway) instead of being ended by the system before the first frame, including when the game has been played on this device before.*
- **修复部分游戏开局就断言退出（本机回环网络连接被拒）**：游戏内部用本机回环连接自我唤醒的，现在能照常连上。
  *Fixed some games quitting at launch with an assertion because a local loopback connection was refused: games that wake themselves through a loopback connection now connect normally.*
- **修复部分要 GLES 3 上下文的 SDL 游戏每局开局即崩（#2057）**。
  *Fixed some SDL games that need a GLES 3 context crashing at the start of every session (#2057).*
- **加载页**：着色器还在编就一直等，不再 30 秒到点硬进游戏；「先开始玩，后台继续优化」从优化画面段一开始就可点（#502）。
  *The loading page keeps waiting while shaders are still compiling instead of entering the game after 30 seconds; "Play now, keep optimizing in the background" is available from the start of the optimization stage (#502).*
- **修复部分游戏战斗时敌人血条不显示、长帧（#2051）**。
  *Fixed enemy health bars missing and long frames during battles in some games (#2051).*
- **画面**：修复贴图池在途改写导致采样读到空图闪烁（#674）；内部分辨率下部分计算着色器不再整遍退回原尺寸；遮挡查询重置、事件信号不再打断几何合批（#1449）；计算着色器常量缓冲里的采样器句柄接通（#1594）。
  *Fixed flicker from textures sampled while the texture pool table was being rewritten (#674); some compute shaders no longer fall back to native size under internal resolution; occlusion query resets and event signals no longer break geometry batching (#1449); sampler handles in compute constant buffers are now wired up (#1594).*
- **部分着色器用桌面 OpenGL 老版本写的游戏（如 Darkest Dungeon）不再有声音、没画面**；已装好的请在电脑上对这款点「更新这款」重出一次（#852，感谢 Tony-loading 反复复测）。
  *Some games whose shaders use older desktop OpenGL versions, such as Darkest Dungeon, no longer play sound over a black screen; if the game is already installed, click "Update this game" on the computer once (#852, thanks to Tony-loading for testing again and again).*
- **长时间游玩后回到去过的地方，地面不再出现一直不消失的黑块**（源自 judeyang 的 #2046）。
  *After long play sessions, revisited areas no longer show black patches on the ground that never go away (from #2046 by judeyang).*
- **修复部分游戏开局时偶发的闪退**。
  *Fixed an occasional crash when some games start.*
- **声音**：iOS 音频被打断（来电、其他 App 占用）时继续回收缓冲，游戏不再重开音频输出；恢复快照后缺失的音效状态会重建。
  *During an iOS audio interruption buffers keep being returned so the game does not reopen its audio output; missing audio effect state is rebuilt after restoring a snapshot.*
- **手柄**：iOS 外接手柄十字键不再慢半拍；手柄断开后保留玩家位、重连回到原位（#2036）；Mac 手柄状态不再与系统并发改写（#1819）；Mac 自动识别北通宙斯 NS 并补齐左摇杆（#2039）；Mac 启动设置关掉「体感」后，系统不认、靠兜底读取的手柄也不再把陀螺仪交给游戏（#1383）。
  *The D-pad on external controllers on iOS no longer lags; a disconnected controller keeps its player slot and returns to it on reconnect (#2036); Mac controller state is no longer rewritten concurrently with the system (#1819); Mac recognizes the Betop Zeus NS and its left stick (#2039); on Mac, turning off motion in launch settings also stops motion from controllers read through the fallback path (#1383).*
- **Windows 上登记过两台设备时「更新」找对连着的那台**：原先总去找记录里排第一的那台，不在线就报「这次没列出来」；现在连着的那台排第一。
  *On Windows, with two devices on record, "Update" now targets the one that's connected instead of always the first record, which failed with "not listed" when that device was offline.*
- **Apple ID 团队里还没登记设备时也能导出**：原先导出报笼统的「本地任务失败」；现在照样导出未签名的游戏包，并说清原因和下一步（连上 iPhone 推一次游戏让它登记进团队）。
  *Exporting now works even when your Apple ID team has no registered devices: instead of a generic "local task failed", it exports an unsigned game package and explains why and what to do next (connect your iPhone and push a game once so it's registered).*
- **手机报「签名证书已失效」时说清原因和办法**：原先只说「设备安装失败」；现在写明是别的签名工具刚撤了证书，或手机日期时间不对，并给出办法（打开「设置 → 通用 → 日期与时间」的自动设置后重试；S2Arm 签名前会重新核证书，被撤的换新）。
  *When the phone reports the signing certificate is no longer valid, S2Arm now explains why (another signing tool just revoked it, or the phone's date and time are wrong) and what to do (turn on automatic date and time, then retry; S2Arm re-checks the certificate before signing and replaces a revoked one), instead of a generic install failure.*
- **出包与装机**：Switch 2 版共用 Switch 1 本体 DLC 号段时不再被拒；Windows 上着色器编译超时连同子进程一起停、不再永远挂住；并发写进度文件不再让出包失败（#2034）；别的工具装的 S2Arm 比启动器旧时，接口兼容就提示后继续（#1842）；空的 RomFS 镜像保留并校验，资源镜像按顺序写出时也显示进度；「更新这款」只重算变了的部分；Apple ID 登录辅助服务器异常、硬盘读写故障、硬盘写满、长时间无进展各有自己的原因句；钥匙串里没有签名身份的证书不再算作手机上的证书。
  *Switch 2 versions that share the Switch 1 base game's DLC range are no longer refused; on Windows a timed-out shader compile is stopped with its child processes instead of hanging; concurrent writes to the progress file no longer fail a build (#2034); an S2Arm installed by another tool that is older than the launcher can continue after a notice when compatible (#1842); empty RomFS images are kept and verified, and ordered resource image writes show progress; "Update this game" recomputes only what changed; Apple ID sign-in helper errors, disk I/O failures, a full disk and long stalls each get their own reason; a certificate without a signing identity in the keychain no longer counts as the phone's certificate.*
- **推过多台手机时，「更新 S2Arm」只看连着的那台**：原先总拿记录里排第一的那台提示、甚至往没连着的那台推；现在有手机连着时提示和按钮只看连着的，Mac 也能认出连着的是哪台（#2088）。
  *If you have pushed to more than one phone, "Update S2Arm" now looks only at the phones currently connected: it no longer prompts for, or pushes to, a phone that isn't connected just because it came first in the records, and the Mac launcher now recognizes which phone is connected (#2088).*
- **D2R-Mobile 下游移植包更新到 v2.3.4**，升级后在 iPhone 上出包不再停在「登记翻译链」这一步。
  *The D2R-Mobile downstream port is updated to v2.3.4; building for iPhone after updating no longer stops at the "registering the translation chain" step.*
- **出包、更新失败时，失败原因的开头写清是什么错**，不再只剩一串调用栈的结尾。
  *When a build or update fails, the reason now starts with what went wrong instead of only the tail of a call stack.*
- **Mac 游戏库：免费签名到期只在选中游戏的设备操作区提示一次**，不再把「可在 Mac 上运行」一起标红；iPhone 版 S2Arm 有新版只在顶栏提示（源自 Xc1Ym 的 #2091）。
  *Mac game library: a free signature's expiry now shows once, in the selected game's device actions, and no longer turns "Can run on Mac" red; a new version of S2Arm for iPhone is announced only in the top bar (from #2091 by Xc1Ym).*
- **接 iPad 时不再写死 iPhone（源自 ChuBL 的 #1962）**：导出页推完程序包后的等待提示、游戏库和大图上的「已推到」都按实际设备写；0.6.9 之前装的记录写「iPhone / iPad」，重新推一次后按设备写。
  *iPad is no longer called iPhone (from ChuBL’s #1962): the wait notice on the export page after pushing a program and the "On …" status in the library and hero view name the actual device; installs from before 0.6.9 read "iPhone / iPad" until the game is pushed again.*
- **Mac 键位弹窗和进游戏用的是同一套（源自 ChuBL 的 #2081）**：这款存的键位文件坏了（不合规、缺字段、不是 JSON）时，弹窗和游戏都回到所有游戏的默认（没设过就是标准键位），弹窗照实提示读不出来；不是 JSON 时也不会再起不了局。
  *The Mac key map window and the game now use the same key map (from ChuBL’s #2081): if this game's saved key map is broken (invalid, incomplete or not JSON), both fall back to your default for all games (or the standard map) and the window says it couldn't be read; a non-JSON file no longer stops the game from starting.*
- **触屏游戏里左键仍当触屏，只要没改左键和鼠标模式（源自 ChuBL 的 #1987 / #2083）**：原先改了任何一个按键、或设了所有游戏的默认，Mac / iPad 都会判成「动过鼠标」，左键又当游戏键、点不了画面上的开始；现在只看左键绑在哪、鼠标模式是什么。
  *In touch games the left click keeps acting as a touch unless you changed the left button or mouse mode (from ChuBL’s #1987 / #2083): changing any other key or setting a default for all games no longer makes Mac / iPad treat the mouse as "changed" and stop letting you tap on-screen buttons.*
- **iPad 改键页「使用鼠标 / 触控板」开关（源自 ChuBL 的 #2072 / #2082）**：只想用键盘玩时关掉它，点触控板就当手指点屏幕（叫出虚拟按键、点画面），不再误按游戏键、不锁指针；按游戏存，可随「设为所有游戏的默认」一起设。
  *"Use mouse / trackpad" switch on the iPad key map page (from ChuBL’s #2072 / #2082): turn it off to play with the keyboard only, and a trackpad click acts like a finger tap (bringing up the on-screen controls or tapping the screen) instead of pressing a game button or locking the pointer; saved per game and included in "Set as default for all games".*
- **iPad 改键页「设为所有游戏的默认」（源自 ChuBL 的 #1987 / #2079）**：调好的一套键位一点设成所有游戏的默认，约 5 秒内可撤销；已单独调过的游戏不受影响，新加的游戏直接用这套。
  *"Set as default for all games" on the iPad key map page (from ChuBL’s #1987 / #2079): make your key map the default for every game in one tap, with about 5 seconds to undo; games you set up separately keep their own, and newly added games use it.*
- **iPad 改键页「清除按键设置」一次清掉键盘键和鼠标键（源自 ChuBL 的 #2071 / #2074）**：原先只清键盘那半，按触控板左键还会触发。
  *"Clear key settings" on the iPad key map page now clears both the keyboard key and the mouse button (from ChuBL’s #2071 / #2074); it used to clear only the keyboard half, so the trackpad click still triggered the button.*
- **「更新这款」做不齐时说清楚原因，缺原件可以就地补（源自 ChuBL 的 #1961）**：分清是没装 Metal 开发工具、要在出包页重新出包，还是原件也不在；原件不在时黄字下给「重新添加原件…」，只认这一款，选错了不改游戏库。
  *"Update this game" now says why it couldn't finish, and you can re-add a missing original right there (from ChuBL’s #1961): it tells apart missing Metal tools, a needed rebuild on the build page, and a missing original; for the last, "Re-add original…" appears under the notice, accepts only this game, and leaves the library unchanged if you pick a different one.*
- **Mac 首页「S2Arm」卡按上次装的设备画 iPad / iPhone（源自 ChuBL 的 #1967）**：不用等点进去现查；不知道是哪种时画通用设备图标；选中后卡片上放 S2Arm 图标。
  *The "S2Arm" card on the Mac home page draws iPad or iPhone from the last install instead of waiting for a live check (from ChuBL’s #1967); an unknown device gets a generic icon, and the selected card shows the S2Arm icon.*
- **Mac 存档页说清楚（源自 ChuBL 的 #2066）**：写明这一页管的是这台 Mac 上的存档；没在这台 Mac 上玩过的游戏，恢复的存档会显示「已放好 N 个文件，第一次在这台 Mac 上启动时放进存档」，可以「不要了」；访达压的 zip 不再带进 `__MACOSX`。
  *Mac save page is clearer (from ChuBL’s #2066): it says it manages the saves on this Mac; for a game never played on this Mac, a restored save shows as waiting to go in the first time you start the game here, and can be discarded; zips made by Finder no longer bring in `__MACOSX`.*
- **iOS 设置里给 S2Arm 单独选的语言全都生效（源自 ChuBL 的 #2069）**：系统是英文、在「设置 → S2Arm → 语言」选了中文时，存档报错、诊断上传等提示也跟着出中文，不再中英混杂。
  *Language chosen for S2Arm in iOS Settings now applies everywhere (from ChuBL’s #2069): with the system in English and S2Arm set to Chinese, save errors and diagnostic upload notices follow the app language too.*
- **其他**：修复一款游戏补丁表竞争导致的偶发崩溃；安卓上出包预编库前后两段接口对不上时退回现编，分离采样器来源不再丢失。
  *Fixed an occasional crash from a race on one game's patch table; on Android, prebuilt pipelines whose stages do not match fall back to compiling on device, and separate sampler sources are kept.*

## 已知变化
- **iOS 26 上少数大型游戏不能存快照**：这些游戏要用的地址范围比系统给 App 的多，放不下快照，游戏内菜单里会写明原因（和存储空间无关，游戏照常能玩）；之前存下的快照照样可以从游戏库恢复。
  *On iOS 26 a few large games cannot save snapshots: they need more address range than the system gives an app, so there is no room for a snapshot. The in-game menu explains why (it is not about storage, and the game plays normally); snapshots saved earlier can still be restored from the game library.*

## 新功能
- **iPhone / iPad 游戏库设置新增「游戏来源」**：把电脑导出的游戏（.s2arm 和 .img）放在外接硬盘等文件夹里，直接从那里玩，不用拷进手机；Mac 游戏库也放在这块盘上时，一块盘两端通用。硬盘要用 APFS 格式；没接上时游戏显示为灰色，接上自动恢复。
  *New on iPhone and iPad: Game sources in the library settings. Put games exported from the computer (.s2arm and .img) in a folder, for example on an external drive, and play them from there without copying them in; with the Mac game library on the same drive, one drive works for both. The drive needs to be APFS; while it isn't connected, its games show greyed out and come back when it is.*
- **iPhone / iPad「存档管理」能导入其他模拟器 / 工具的存档（源自 ChuBL 的 #2070）**：「选择备份并检查…」除了 S2Arm 的 .s2asave，也能选 JKSV、Checkpoint、Ryujinx、yuzu 等的存档文件夹或 zip；确认后先备份当前存档，下次开始游戏时读入。只选了单个存档文件或认不出时会说清楚原因。
  *"Manage saves" on iPhone / iPad can import saves from other emulators and tools (from ChuBL’s #2070): besides S2Arm .s2asave backups, "Choose a backup to check…" accepts a save folder or zip from JKSV, Checkpoint, Ryujinx, yuzu and others; your current save is backed up first and the new one is loaded the next time you start the game. Picking a single save file or an unrecognized save now explains why.*
- **iOS「分配玩家」与实体手柄改键**（源自 Ting2024 的 #1606）：游戏内齿轮菜单「分配玩家…」，在哪只手柄上按一下键就登记成下一位玩家，与 Mac 同一份顺序表；实体手柄按这一款的键位改键。
  *iOS "Assign players" and physical controller remapping (from Ting2024's #1606): choose "Assign Players…" in the in-game gear menu and press a button on each controller to register players in order, using the same order table as Mac; physical controllers follow the game's key map.*
- **Mac 手柄**：关掉「切到别的窗口时暂停」后，切到别的窗口手柄照样操作游戏；启动器录键可以录修饰键组合；分配玩家时兜底读取的手柄接上即加入（#1151）。
  *Mac controllers keep controlling the game in other windows when "Pause when switching away" is off; the launcher can record modifier-key combinations; controllers read through the fallback path join as soon as they connect when assigning players (#1151).*
- **Mac 可直接把游戏与 Mod 推到 LiveContainer**，并显示导入与删除状态（#2010、#2012）。
  *Mac can push games and mods directly to LiveContainer and shows import and removal status (#2010, #2012).*

## Erosion-CN v1.0.6 (Build 31)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **System Compatibility / 系统兼容性提示**  
> - **Supported / 完整支持**：`iOS / iPadOS 27.0 – 27.2.1` and `27.3 beta 1` (`24C503*`).  
> - **Patched / 已封堵**：Apple patched `worse_query` starting in **`iOS 27.3 beta 2` (`24C5049d+`)**. Do **NOT** update past `27.3 beta 1` if you rely on Erosion-CN.

---

### What's New / 更新内容

1. **General Splash Ad Blocker Whitelist & Manual Manager (`AdWhitelistStore` / `AdWhitelistManagerSheet`) / 去广告应用与路径通用白名单及手动管理面板** *(Thanks to [@appleoner](https://github.com/appleoner) for suggesting [#56](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/56) / 感谢 [@appleoner](https://github.com/appleoner) 在 [#56](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/56) 提出建议)*
   - **Dedicated Whitelist Manager (`白名单`)**：Added top-bar & Overview card entry points supporting **manual `Bundle ID` / `AppGroup ID` entry**, **quick-picking from installed third-party containers**, **manual container subpath entry**, and one-tap deletion of rules.
   - **Per-App, Per-Path & File Browser Controls**：Whitelist an entire app + its matching `group.<bundleID>` AppGroups from the container `⋯` menu, exempt a specific folder/config via the row **Ignore (`加白`)** button, or long-press any file/folder in **File Browser** → **Add to Ad Whitelist**.
   - **Auto-Skip & Auto-Restore**：Whitelisted apps and paths automatically skip global **Lock All** (`一键全锁`) and immediately restore `0755`/`0644` writable permissions (cleaning `.erosion_adlock`) when added. Includes a removable default crash-guard entry for **SMZDM (`什么值得买` · `com.smzdm.client.ios`)**.

2. **Built-In Taobao Splash Boot Paths / 内置手机淘宝开屏启动图与配置路径识别** *(Thanks to [@guestwrt](https://github.com/guestwrt) for sharing in [#56](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/56) / 感谢 [@guestwrt](https://github.com/guestwrt) 在 [#56](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/56) 实测反馈)*
   - Added `Documents/TBDocuments/bootImagebiz` and `Documents/TBDocuments/bootImageDoc` for **Taobao (`com.taobao.taobao4iphone`)**, enabling automatic detection and one-tap anti-recreate `0555`/`0444` locking alongside `TanxAd`, `TanxSDK`, and `SplashAd`.

3. **Native Battery Cycle & Manufacture Date Guard on iPhone 15+ & Modern iPads / iPhone 15 系列及以上电池循环原生支持提示** *(Thanks to [@guestwrt](https://github.com/guestwrt) for reporting [#55](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/55) / 感谢 [@guestwrt](https://github.com/guestwrt) 在 [#55](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/55) 反馈)*
   - Automatically detects models that natively show Battery Cycle Count and Manufacture Date in iOS/iPadOS 17.4+ Settings (iPhone 15 series+ and M2/M4+ iPads), locking `[Beta] Show Battery Cycle Count & Manufacture Date on Legacy Devices` when disabled or advising users to turn it off if previously enabled.

> 📜 Full changelog / 完整更新日志：**[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)** · User Guide / 使用指南：**[USAGE_GUIDE.md](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/blob/main/USAGE_GUIDE.md)**

---

### Install & Checksum / 下载安装与校验

- **SideStore / AltStore / Feather Official Source / 官方更新源**：`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/main/apps.json` *(auto-synced by CI after release / 发版后由 GitHub Actions 自动同步)*
- **IPA Asset / 安装包文件**：`Erosion_v1.0.6_Bilingual.ipa` (`6,948,787` bytes; preserve `App Group` entitlements when signing)
- **SHA-256**：`72165f09450c9477dcd980b7f0858b8d93f881a825fb76ee2c3d62698d7d7e55`

> **Requires:** iOS 26.0 – 26.7.2, or iOS 27.0 up to 27.3 beta 1. **Not supported:** iOS 27.3 beta 2 and later, where Apple patched worse_query. Tested on iOS 27.0.1, 27.2.1, 27.3 beta 1 (confirmed by a user) and 26.7.1; see [Tested devices](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles#tested-devices).
> **Needs:** a sideloading tool that keeps the App Group entitlement; see [Signing](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles#signing-the-app-group) in the README.

# Worse Query Files 0.9.20

Apps Manager backups, and safer handling of databases that are in use.

## New

- **Import Apps Manager backups** ([#19](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/19)): **Apps** → tap the app → **Import as Backup…** now accepts `.adbk` files from Apps Manager. The app's data is saved as a normal WQ Files backup, ready to restore.
  - Only the app's own data folder is imported. App Group data in the file isn't, because WQ Files backups don't include App Groups. The keychain items Apps Manager saves are encrypted, so they can't be imported either. When you import, WQ Files lists what it left out.
  - If the file says it belongs to a different app than the one you tapped, WQ Files asks first, as with any other import.
  - Opening an `.adbk` from the Files app or the share sheet doesn't start an import; start it from Apps.

## Fixed

- **Files another app is using:** deleting or replacing them, for example an app's database in its App Group while the app runs, failed with "Resource temporarily unavailable (errno 35)". WQ Files now says another app is using the file and that quitting that app and trying again should work. Its extensions or widgets can keep the file open even after you quit it.
- **Databases in use stay intact:** an app's database comes with `-wal` and `-shm` files next to it, and while the app runs, iOS doesn't lock the `-wal` file. WQ Files could delete or replace it while refusing the database file, which lost the app's newest data. Now a database and its `-wal`, `-shm` and `-journal` files are only changed together: if one of them is in use, none of them is touched. This applies to deleting (also whole folders), replacing on import and editing.
- **Deleting or importing several files at once:** each database is handled before its `-wal` and `-shm` files, which are skipped if the database itself couldn't be deleted or replaced. "N of M files were imported" is translated now.

## Credit

New design: GpGp700. Sandbox technique: [worse_query](https://github.com/forcequitOS/worse_query) by Taj C (forcequit). Container enumeration: [KAMUI](https://github.com/murk-sus/kamui-escape) by murk-sus. Resumable scans: hhh2210. Custom inspectors idea: deltaII. Translations: iosrxwy and FrogTool (Simplified Chinese), kinboy56 (Japanese), hfip (Arabic), hooray804 (Korean), Reinascape (Russian), romlayvn-93 (Vietnamese), buraakkcayir (Turkish review). Thanks to braless for the Apps Manager sample, and to everyone who sent screenshots and Logs. GPL-3.0-or-later.

apps.localizedDescription:
## What's new?

3.4 is a compatibility release. About 97% of the 472 F-Droid apps we test now run, up from 85%. On the 169 Play Store apps we test, about 90% run, not counting apps with anti-tamper or fraud protection, which Husk doesn't try to bypass. All of these numbers are from testing on a Mac.

### More Android apps
- Microsoft Word opens (Excel and PowerPoint share its libraries)
- Slack, Gmail, Teams, Deezer, Flipboard and Picsart get past the crashes that stopped them
- More engines and frameworks start: React Native's new architecture, Qt 6 / QML, and apps using JavaScriptCore
- libGDX and other OpenGL apps draw again (3.3 broke these)
- Apps that keep secrets in Android's secure key store work better
- Apps with big bundled databases open
- UPnP and network discovery apps can start
- Apps that declare their launch screen in a split APK can start

### Looks better
- Rounded buttons are proper pills instead of ellipses
- Toolbars, window backgrounds and more color formats behave like they do on a phone

### Less "out of memory"
- Fewer `OutOfMemoryError: pthread_create` crashes on installs without extended address space
- Unity games use less address space on sideloaded installs, and keep their frame rate up
- New in Settings -> Performance: see whether Increased Memory Limit and Extended Address Space are on for your install

### Also
- Japanese, thanks to @Yuki-1018
- Fixed Husk crashing when importing a `.p12`, or at launch with one saved on iOS 27 (#220)
- The Remove and Uninstall dialogs open next to their buttons on iPad (#218)
- Winlator's Settings page no longer crashes
- Husk builds with Xcode 27 and the iOS 27 SDK

## Known Issues
- Without JIT, Minecraft, some Flutter apps and some LÖVE games can fail. Use StikJIT for those for now
- Browsers (Firefox, Brave, Opera) don't run yet because they need separate helper processes
- Husk's Java runtime still has no garbage collector, so big apps can run out of memory in long sessions (#191)
- Touch doesn't work yet in Godot 3 games (#200)
- Apps with anti-tamper still won't run, and neither will apps that need Google Play services or a Google account
- Winlator containers don't run
- Full Android is still slow. Use the translation layer for games

## Thanks
Thanks to @BartolomeoRusso9, @Dey410 and @Yuki-1018 for their pull requests, and to everyone who sent logs. Crash reports are what made this release possible ❤️

## Links
- Website: https://itslevii.dev

## iPadn 2.3.5

**目录 / Contents**：[简体中文](#-核心修复与优化) · [TestFlight 说明与免责](#-testflight-实验性说明与免责声明) · [English](#english) · [TestFlight Notice](#testflight-experimental-notice--disclaimer)

本次为 **v2.3.5** 稳定性修复与体验升级版：根治 **iOS 16.0–16.2 强链接符号闪退**、**iOS 27.2 beta 2 历史版本加载闪退** 与 **iPadOS 全屏/专业模式导航栏异常**；**TestFlight 现支持切换下载 Apple TV 等多平台测试包**并统一展示单色客户端标识，同时修复大型/多变体游戏误报「产物校验失败，已清理」及详情页顶部虚化异常；在「设置 › 外观与图标」开放**自定义全部 177 个 Apple 商店地区**（支持搜索筛选、勾选、拖拽排序与国旗展示）；并修复 FairPlay 高熵插件误拒、登录 `5020`/2FA 提示、未购免费应用首次获取旧版报错与「应用包」批量导入打断问题。安装包均未签名，请使用自用签名工具签名后安装。

### 🔧 核心修复与优化

- **修复 iOS 16/27 闪退与 iPadOS 专业模式导航异常**
  - 移除强链接 iOS 17+/18+ 的 `UnevenRoundedRectangle` 与全部 `.onGeometryChange` 调用，改用向后兼容路径与几何读取实现，根治 iOS 16.0 / 16.0.2 / 16.2 打开界面或卡片时因动态符号缺失导致的闪退。
  - 修复 iOS 27.2 beta 2 在应用详情页加载历史版本时偶发崩溃的问题（修正版本行布局优先级与骨架屏几何回调防抖阈值）。
  - 修复 iPadOS 全屏及开启「专业模式」后导航栏切换错乱、标题丢失与工具栏按钮跨标签泄露的问题，改为按当前活动标签隔离独立导航栈。
- **TestFlight 支持 Apple TV 多平台下载、校验修复与顶部优化**
  - TestFlight 详情页新增多平台切换（如 `iOS` / `Apple TV`），支持直接下载 Apple TV（tvOS）测试包，并与同一应用的 iOS 测试包独立索引、互不覆盖。
  - 在「下载」「应用包」「存储空间」「包体详情」「解密详情」等全应用页面为 Apple TV 等非 iPhone 包并列展示单色客户端图标（紧邻单色 TestFlight 图标）；点击 TestFlight 任务与安装包详情均可查看来源、客户端与对应最低系统版本（如 `tvOS`）；Apple TV 测试包下载后与常规商店包一致不显示「安装」按钮且不触发自动安装。

**v2.3.5** delivers key stability fixes and highly requested improvements: eliminates **iOS 16.0–16.2 strong-linked symbol crashes**, **iOS 27.2 beta 2 version-history crashes**, and **iPadOS full-screen / Pro mode toolbar & navigation bugs**; adds **multi-platform TestFlight downloads (including Apple TV)** with monochrome client badges, fixes false validation rejections on large/multi-variant games, and polishes the TestFlight detail top blur; opens a searchable, reorderable **177-region Storefront picker** under Settings › Appearance & icon; and resolves FairPlay high-entropy false rejections, login `5020`/2FA messaging, first-time free-app license retries, and multi-IPA batch import interruptions. #### Fixes & Improvements Since v2.3.4

- **Fix iOS 16/27 Crashes & iPadOS Pro Mode Navigation**
  - Removes strong-linked iOS 17+/18+ `UnevenRoundedRectangle` and all `.onGeometryChange` usages in favor of backward-compatible paths and geometry observers, resolving launch and view crashes on iOS 16.0 / 16.0.2 / 16.2.
  - Fixes a crash on iOS 27.2 beta 2 when loading version history on App Detail by stabilizing row layout priorities and shimmer geometry change thresholds.
  - Fixes missing titles, broken navigation, and leaked cross-tab toolbars in iPadOS full-screen & Pro mode by isolating a single active `NavigationStack` per tab.
- **TestFlight Apple TV Support, Validation & Hero Blur Fix**
  - Adds platform switching (`iOS` / `Apple TV`, etc.) on TestFlight detail pages to download Apple TV (tvOS) beta IPAs alongside iOS builds, indexed cleanly per `(bundle, platform)`.
  - Places monochrome platform icons beside the monochrome TestFlight icon across **Downloads**, **Packages**, **Storage**, **Package Info**, and **Decryption Detail**; displays source, client platform, and accurate minimum OS (e.g., `tvOS`) in task & package details; hides the Install button and skips Auto-Install for Apple TV IPAs just like regular App Store Apple TV downloads.
  - Fixes false "validation failed, cleaned up" errors on large or multi-variant TestFlight games via streaming Mach-O header prefix reads, FAT 32/64-bit `cryptid` inspection, accurate SINF replacement counting, and `packages.full`-first variant selection.
  - Eliminates the light top-edge blur band on TestFlight detail pages using opaque hero blur and native navigation bar appearance syncing.
- **Customizable 177 Storefront Regions with Search & Reorder**
  - Adds **Settings › Appearance & icon › Storefront Regions** covering all **177** Apple App Store regions (including `AF` and `LI`).
  - Supports instant search by localized name, English name, or ISO‑2 code (with exact ISO‑2 matches ranked first), tap-to-toggle, drag-to-reorder, flag + code display, and one-tap **Reset to Defaults**.
- **FairPlay, Login/License Retry & Batch Import Fixes**
  - Fixes on-device FairPlay decryption falsely rejecting legitimate high-entropy plugin binaries (such as `_codecs_cn`) by accepting verified decrypted instruction streams.
  - Improves App Store sign-in `5020` / 2FA messaging and adds staged `SAPSigner` failure diagnostics.
  - Automatically invalidates stale version caches and performs short backoff retries after acquiring a free app license so first-time older-version fetches no longer fail on transient `9610` delays.
  - Fixes multi-IPA batch import in **Packages** prematurely opening a detail sheet mid-batch, adding live `(done/total)` progress, batch completion toast, and a dismissible error banner.
